title: GateDispatchRequest
description: TACT-ORCH-001 Authoritative Dispatch Request Schema for Single Dispatcher Gateway

conversation_id.description: Unique identifier of the customer conversation/LiveKit room (e.g. conv-customer-a-enquiry)

idempotency_key.description: Unique deduplication key generated by client; identical keys must yield cached outcomes

actor_guid.description: GUID of the user initiating the dispatch

meeting_port_context.description: Optional WebRTC / meeting port telemetry context
